source.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
source.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source.basis: NIST AI RMF 1.0 plus NIST AI RMF Playbook
source.note: Internal implementation profile. Adoption does not imply NIST certification, endorsement, or legal compliance.

appliesTo: registered agents, models, services, repositories, tools, and third-party AI components

requirements: document roles and human accountability
document applicable legal and regulatory context
maintain AI system inventory
define risk tolerance and escalation
maintain monitoring and incident response
maintain third-party risk controls
maintain decommissioning procedures
document intended purpose and context of use
identify affected actors and dependencies
record assumptions, limitations, benefits, harms, and human oversight
identify third-party components and supply-chain risks
define risk likelihood and impact
define metrics and thresholds
perform testing, evaluation, verification, and validation
record evidence and known measurement limits
prefer independent review for high-risk decisions
monitor drift, incidents, security, bias, and reliability
prioritize risk by impact and likelihood
choose and document mitigate, transfer, avoid, or accept treatment
document residual risk
support approve, conditional, hold, deny, bypass, rollback, and decommission decisions
preserve evidence for incident and forensic review
